results.title: Mahama urges stronger Ghana-UK ties, welcomes UK openness to reparations dialogue
results.content: President John Mahama has called for stronger relations between Ghana and the United Kingdom, saying the changing global order presents an opportunity for countries that share democratic values and support multilateral cooperation to deepen their partnerships. Speaking during a meeting with the UK Prime Minister, President Mahama said the two countries had a long history of relations and shared values, including democracy, respect for human rights and constitutional governance. He said the changing global architecture made it important for countries with common interests to forge stronger partnerships. “The whole global architecture is unraveling, and I think that this is a time for us to forge stronger partnerships between countries that believe in a multilateral system, a global system,” he said.
